options.zh: 這位男士正把麥克風遞給一位女士。

options.en: Two people are leaving their seats.
options.zh: 兩個人正要離開座位。

options.en: The man is holding a microphone in one hand.
options.zh: 這位男士一手拿著麥克風。

options.en: The speaker is sitting beside a plant.
options.zh: 講者正坐在一盆植物旁邊。

options.en: There are laptops and glasses on the table.
options.zh: 桌上有筆電和玻璃杯。

options.en: A woman is pouring water into a glass.
options.zh: 一位女士正把水倒進玻璃杯裡。

options.en: The people are leaving the meeting room.
options.zh: 這些人正離開會議室。

options.en: A man is closing the window.
options.zh: 一位男士正在關窗戶。

options.en: A man is hanging a clock on the wall.
options.zh: 一位男士正把時鐘掛到牆上。

options.en: A man is carrying a monitor across the room.
options.zh: 一位男士正搬著螢幕穿過房間。

options.en: A man is standing behind a desk.
options.zh: 一位男士正站在書桌後面。

options.en: A man is looking at a computer screen.
options.zh: 一位男士正看著電腦螢幕。

options.en: A man is putting a cup on a small table.
options.zh: 一位男士正把杯子放到小桌子上。

options.en: A man is enjoying a hot drink.
options.zh: 一位男士正在享用一杯熱飲。

options.en: A man is writing on a board.
options.zh: 一位男士正在板子上寫字。

options.en: A man is opening the window.
options.zh: 一位男士正在開窗戶。

options.en: A woman is drawing a chart on the wall.
options.zh: 一位女士正在牆上畫圖表。

options.en: A woman is writing on the screen.
options.zh: 一位女士正在螢幕上寫字。

options.en: Two people are shaking hands near the screen.
options.zh: 兩個人正在螢幕旁邊握手。

options.en: A woman is showing a chart to an audience.
options.zh: 一位女士正在向聽眾展示一張圖表。

options.en: Two people are seated at their desks.
options.zh: 兩個人正坐在自己的桌子前。

options.en: A woman is cleaning the board.
options.zh: 一位女士正在擦黑板。

options.en: Two students are writing on the board.
options.zh: 兩個學生正在黑板上寫字。

options.en: A woman is opening a window.
options.zh: 一位女士正在開窗戶。

options.en: A woman is putting a letter in an envelope.
options.zh: 一位女士正把信放進信封裡。

options.en: A woman is turning off a lamp.
options.zh: 一位女士正在關檯燈。

options.en: A woman is holding a pen.
options.zh: 一位女士正拿著一支筆。

options.en: A woman is hanging a picture on the wall.
options.zh: 一位女士正把一幅畫掛到牆上。

options.en: A woman is putting books on a shelf.
options.zh: 一位女士正把書放到架子上。

options.en: A woman is sitting in a red chair.
options.zh: 一位女士正坐在一張紅色椅子上。

options.en: A woman is moving a chair.
options.zh: 一位女士正在搬椅子。

options.en: A woman is buying a magazine.
options.zh: 一位女士正在買雜誌。

responses.en: In the boardroom on the third floor.
It's been moved to Thursday morning.

prompt.en: Who's giving the presentation on Friday?
Why don't we print the flyers this week?
prompt.zh: 我們何不這個星期就把傳單印出來？

responses.zh: 他們上週搭飛機過來的。

responses.en: Good idea. I'll call the printer today.
responses.zh: 好主意。我今天就打給印刷廠。

prompt.en: Has the new assistant signed his contract yet?

responses.en: The new contract is three pages long.
He's coming in to do it tomorrow.

prompt.en: Where should we hold the training session?
prompt.zh: 我們應該在哪裡辦培訓課程？

responses.en: The meeting room on the second floor is free.

prompt.en: Would you like me to email you the spreadsheet, or should I print it?
prompt.zh: 你要我用 email 寄試算表給你，還是印出來？

responses.en: The printer is on the left.

prompt.en: How often do you check the samples?
prompt.zh: 你們多久檢查一次樣品？

prompt.en: The new lamps sold out in two days.

responses.en: The lamp is on my desk.
That's great news. Should we order more?
responses.zh: 真是好消息。我們要再訂一些嗎？

prompt.en: Isn't your company hiring this year?
prompt.zh: 你們公司今年不是有在徵人嗎？

responses.en: Yes, we're looking for five new designers.
responses.zh: 有，我們在找五位新的設計師。
是 Ellis 先生，上週核准的。

prompt.en: Where can I find the new lamps?
prompt.zh: 新的燈在哪裡可以找到？

responses.en: They're near the front door, on the left.

prompt.en: Can you help me move these desks this afternoon?
prompt.zh: 你今天下午可以幫我搬這些桌子嗎？

responses.en: I moved here two years ago.
Sure, what time works for you?

prompt.zh: 你的試用期什麼時候結束？

responses.en: It was about five hundred lamps.
The truck broke down on the way.

prompt.en: Should we include delivery costs in the forecast, or keep them separate?
prompt.zh: 我們要把運費算進預測裡，還是分開列？

responses.en: Let's keep them separate for now.

prompt.en: Do you want to see the lab before lunch or after?
prompt.zh: 你想在午餐前還是午餐後參觀實驗室？

prompt.en: The internet in the new office still isn't working.
prompt.zh: 新辦公室的網路還是不能用。

responses.en: I'll call the company again this afternoon.
responses.zh: 我今天下午會再打給那家公司。

responses.en: The new office opens at nine.

prompt.en: Haven't you seen the new contract?

responses.en: Not yet. Could you send it to me?

lines.en: I'm booking a room for Thursday's training session. How many people are coming?
lines.zh: 我在訂星期四培訓課程的會議室。會有多少人來？

lines.en: Twenty new staff members signed up, plus the two instructors.
lines.zh: 有二十位新進同仁報名，再加上兩位講師。

lines.en: Then the small rooms won't work.
lines.zh: 那小的會議室就不行了。

lines.en: No. And we'll need a screen for the slides.
lines.zh: 對。而且我們需要一個螢幕放投影片。

lines.en: Room 202 has enough seats, but it doesn't have one.
lines.zh: 202 室座位夠，可是沒有螢幕。

lines.en: What about the large room on the third floor?
lines.zh: 那三樓的大會議室呢？

lines.en: It's free all day. I'll book it right now.
lines.zh: 它整天都空著。我現在就訂。

lines.en: Great. Could you also order lunch? The session runs until three.
lines.zh: 太好了。你也可以訂午餐嗎？課程會上到三點。

lines.en: Sure. Should I get sandwiches again?
lines.zh: 沒問題。要再訂三明治嗎？

lines.en: Actually, people complained about them last time. Let's ask the restaurant downstairs for hot meals.
lines.zh: 其實上次大家對三明治有抱怨。我們請樓下的餐廳準備熱食吧。

questions.en: Look at the table. Which room will the man book?
questions.zh: 請看表格。這位男士會訂哪一間會議室？

questions.en: Who will attend the training session?
questions.zh: 誰會參加這次培訓課程？

questions.en: What does the woman indicate about the last session?
questions.zh: 關於上一次的課程，這位女士透露了什麼？

lines.en: Thanks for calling back. Our lamp bases still haven't arrived, and the factory needs them on Monday.
lines.zh: 謝謝你回電。我們的燈座還沒到，工廠星期一就要用。

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. The order left our warehouse yesterday, but the truck had to go back for a repair.
lines.zh: 很抱歉。貨昨天就從我們倉庫出發了，但卡車得回去修理。

lines.en: So when can we expect it? We're closed on Saturday.
lines.zh: 那我們什麼時候可以收到？我們星期六不開。

lines.en: It should reach you on Friday afternoon, around four.
lines.zh: 應該星期五下午四點左右會到。

lines.en: That's late. My team usually goes home at five.
lines.zh: 那很晚了。我的組員通常五點就下班。

lines.en: Could you ask two people to stay a little later on Friday? We can't miss Monday.
lines.zh: 你可以請兩個人星期五晚一點走嗎？星期一不能延誤。

lines.en: I'll ask. They'll want to be paid for the extra hours, though.
lines.zh: 我會問問看。不過他們會希望多出來的時數有加班費。

lines.en: That's fine. And since the order is late, could you take something off the price?
lines.zh: 沒問題。還有，既然這批貨晚到，價格可以算便宜一點嗎？

lines.en: I can give you five percent off this order. I'll email you a new invoice today.
lines.zh: 這張訂單我可以給你們打九五折。我今天會用 email 寄新的發票給你們。

lines.en: Thank you. Please call us when the truck leaves.
lines.zh: 謝謝。卡車出發時請打電話給我們。

questions.zh: 是什麼讓這批貨延誤了？
options: The warehouse was closed on Saturday.
A vehicle needed to be fixed.
The lamp bases failed a test.

questions.en: What does the warehouse lead mean when he says, "They'll want to be paid for the extra hours"?
questions.zh: 倉管說「他們會希望多出來的時數有加班費」，意思是什麼？
options: His team does not want to work on Monday.
Staying late will cost more money.

questions.en: What will the supplier send today?
questions.zh: 廠商業務今天會寄什麼？

lines.en: I've put together four ways to advertise the Lantern series over the next few months.
lines.zh: 我整理了四種接下來幾個月替 Lantern 系列打廣告的方式。

lines.en: Thanks. Our budget is tight, so I'd like to stay under three thousand a month.
lines.zh: 謝謝。我們預算很緊，所以我希望每個月控制在三千以下。

lines.en: Then the radio and the bus signs are out.
lines.zh: 那廣播和公車廣告就不考慮了。

lines.en: What about the magazine? Many office workers read it on the train.
lines.zh: 那雜誌呢？很多上班族會在火車上看。

lines.en: It looks nice, but it's hard to know how many people actually see an ad.
lines.zh: 雜誌看起來很好看，但很難知道到底有多少人看到廣告。

lines.en: True. With videos, we can count the views, right?
lines.zh: 說得對。影片的話，我們可以算觀看次數，對吧？

lines.en: Exactly. And people can share them with their friends for free.
lines.zh: 沒錯。而且大家可以免費分享給朋友。

lines.en: All right, let's go with that. Can we start in early May?
lines.zh: 好，就這麼決定。我們可以五月初開始嗎？

lines.en: Yes, but I'll need photos of the lamps by the end of this month.
lines.zh: 可以，但這個月底前我需要燈的照片。

lines.en: I'll ask our designer to send them next week.
lines.zh: 我會請我們的設計師下週寄給你。

questions.en: Look at the table. How much will the company spend on advertising each month?
questions.zh: 請看表格。這家公司每個月會花多少錢打廣告？

questions.en: Why does the woman advise against the magazine?
questions.zh: 這位女士為什麼不建議用雜誌？
options: It costs more than the budget allows.
Its results are difficult to measure.
It cannot start in early May.

questions.en: What will the man probably do next week?
questions.zh: 這位男士下週可能會做什麼？
options: Sign a contract with a radio station.
Count the views of a video.

lines.en: Welcome to the team. This is Dan from sales. He'll help you during your first few weeks.
lines.zh: 歡迎加入團隊。這位是業務部的 Dan。你剛來的這幾週他會幫你。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. Has anyone shown you the order system yet?
lines.zh: 很高興認識你。有人帶你看過訂單系統了嗎？

lines.en: Not yet. I've only filled out some forms with HR this morning.
lines.zh: 還沒。我今天早上只跟人資填了一些表格。

lines.en: Then let's start with that after lunch. It isn't hard, but there are a lot of steps.
lines.zh: 那我們午餐後就從那個開始。不難，但步驟很多。

lines.en: Should I take notes, or is there a guide I can read?
lines.zh: 我應該做筆記，還是有說明可以看？

lines.en: There's a booklet, but it's a bit old. Your own notes will be more useful.
lines.zh: 有一本小手冊，但有點舊了。你自己的筆記會比較有用。

lines.en: Could you also take him to Thursday's seminar on customer calls, Dan?
lines.zh: Dan，你也可以帶他去星期四講客戶電話的研討會嗎？

lines.en: Sure. I'll sign him up today.
lines.zh: 沒問題。我今天就幫他報名。

lines.en: Thank you. Is there anything I should do before then?
lines.zh: 謝謝。在那之前我有什麼該做的嗎？

lines.en: Just listen to how Dan handles a few calls this week.
lines.zh: 這個星期就聽聽 Dan 怎麼處理幾通電話。

questions.en: What will the new employee learn after lunch?
questions.zh: 新員工午餐後會學什麼？
options: How to fill out forms for HR.
How to use the order system.

questions.en: What does the man from sales suggest about the booklet?
questions.zh: 業務部的男士對那本小手冊有什麼看法？
options: It is not fully up to date.
It is too long to read.

questions.en: What will the new employee most likely do this week?
questions.zh: 新員工這個星期最可能做什麼？
options: Listen to a coworker on the phone.
Give a talk at a seminar.
